title: Timezone Converter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: Convert UTC to local time for seven time zones with integer second arithmetic, a world map of time-zone bands, a DST toggle, highlighted date rollovers, and a Predict mode.

learningObjectives: Apply time zone offsets to convert UTC to local time
Identify when a conversion crosses midnight and changes the date

keyQuestions: When does converting UTC to local time change the date?
How does DST change the offset?
commonMisconceptions: Local time always has the same date as UTC
All time zones are whole hours
assessmentOpportunities: Convert 23:00 UTC to Central European time and give the date
